**Bottom line**  
PMID 39369609 reports a real-world observational study titled “Real-world comparative effectiveness of sotorasib versus docetaxel in second line and beyond among patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)” that compared sotorasib monotherapy with docetaxel (monotherapy or combination) in pretreated KRAS G12C-mutated advanced NSCLC. An erratum exists (PMID 39984314) and was retrieved, but the correction notice contained no abstract or text, so no corrected content was applied. In the second-line (2L) setting, sotorasib (N = 102) had median OS 10.2 months (95 % CI 7.6–16.3) versus docetaxel (N = 58) median OS 6.0 months (95 % CI 4.2–11.0) with mortality HR 0.62 (95 % CI 0.41–0.93); in the 2L + setting, sotorasib (N = 164) median OS 10.2 months (95 % CI 8.0–14.6) versus docetaxel (N = 116) median OS 7.2 months (95 % CI 5.1–10.6) with mortality HR 0.65 (95 % CI 0.49–0.87).  

**Confidence:** moderate (single observational real-world study; effect estimates derived from propensity-weighted Cox models).

### 1. Exact title, disease population, and study design  
- **Title:** Real-world comparative effectiveness of sotorasib versus docetaxel in second line and beyond among patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) (PMID: 39369609)  
- **Disease population:** Patients with pretreated KRAS G12C-mutated advanced NSCLC who had received prior anti-PD-(L)1 therapy and/or platinum-based chemotherapy (PMID: 39369609)  
- **Study design:** Observational retrospective cohort using a US-based electronic health record-derived de-identified database, with overlap-weighting propensity score methods to balance treatment groups (PMID: 39369609)  

### 2. Correction status  
- An erratum exists for PMID 39369609 (PMID 39984314).

- The correction notice carried no abstract or text, so corrected content was **not applied**.
